match_rule: A security-audit follow-up is waived when its finding_id equals a waiver's finding_id, or when it cites the same file and the same owasp_or_stride_category (whitespace/case-insensitive) within 40 lines of the waiver's line (SECURITY_AUDIT_WAIVER_LINE_WINDOW default, security_pass_apply_waivers_to_findings in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh).

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A01:2021-Broken Access Control / STRIDE: Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: model_provider_broker.py:103-187 now restricts models, output limits, modalities, and prices; lines 279-310 bound requests and total output. Add automated aggregate input/cost accounting as a non-blocking follow-up.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A04:2021-Insecure Design / STRIDE: Tampering, Denial of Service
waivers.justification: orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8478-8586 verifies signed comments and bounds scans, but a forged numeric body locator bypasses status lookup before fallback. This authenticated, bounded DoS should get an automated status-first follow-up.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_autofix.yml:3457-3479 supplies GH_TOKEN, while review_run_reviewers.sh:134-137 starts normal Python with ${PWD}/scripts on PYTHONPATH. Follow up by using python3 -I -B and explicit immutable-support imports.

finding.exploit_scenario: A same-repository PR can add scripts/sitecustomize.py; review_run_reviewers launches normal Python with that directory on PYTHONPATH inside a GH_PAT-bearing step, automatically executing the PR code.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Run helper Python with python3 -I -B, clear PYTHONPATH, and explicitly insert only the immutable support directory before importing support modules.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_autofix.yml:5200-5228 supplies GH_TOKEN, and review_rb_judge.sh:291-294 and 438-441 expose the PR scripts path to Python startup. The existing isolated-import pattern can be applied automatically.

finding.exploit_scenario: On review exhaustion, review_rb_judge runs Python with the PR's scripts directory on PYTHONPATH while the step holds GH_PAT, allowing sitecustomize.py to execute and steal or misuse it.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Use python3 -I -B for all transitive judge Python calls and import modules exclusively from the immutable support bundle.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A01:2021-Broken Access Control / STRIDE: Tampering, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: codex_stall_guard.sh:299-305 creates only a process group, and editor isolation verifies survivors by that PGID before restoring ownership. Extend the writer launch with the existing PID-namespace kill-child pattern so setsid cannot escape teardown.

finding.exploit_scenario: A writer can use setsid to escape the monitored process group while retaining a writable worktree file descriptor, then alter files after validation and before trusted commit or push.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A01:2021-Broken Access Control / STRIDE: Tampering, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Contain each writer in a dedicated PID namespace or cgroup, terminate and verify the entire container or cgroup, and restore ACLs only after it is empty.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_apply_fixes.sh:576-579 executes Python with ${PWD}/scripts before editor isolation starts at 2194-2199, while the workflow job carries the provider credential. Replace it with isolated Python and explicit immutable-support imports.

finding.exploit_scenario: A PR-supplied scripts/sitecustomize.py executes before the budget helper import with the runner's provider credential and command-file environment, enabling key theft or persistence into later GH_PAT steps.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Remove checkout paths from PYTHONPATH and invoke isolated Python with only the verified immutable support directory added explicitly.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A03:2021-Injection / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_rb_judge.sh:1903-1937 launches a writer through the same runner UID, then commits detected changes at 1971 onward. Reuse model_provider_broker_prepare_isolated_writer with a detached workspace and validated allowlist.

finding.exploit_scenario: When the judge selects fix, untrusted PR context drives an unrestricted OpenCode writer running as the runner UID, after which the parent step commits and pushes its arbitrary changes using GH_PAT.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A03:2021-Injection / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Run review-blocked fixes under a dedicated UID in a disposable worktree, deny runner command-file access, validate an explicit file allowlist, and commit only after full cgroup teardown.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A03:2021-Injection / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_apply_fixes.sh:1202-1208 invokes consolidation before isolation, while review_consolidate.sh:578-608 configures the model as writer with unrestricted tools. Run it as a read-only reviewer under a separate UID and accept only schema-validated output.

finding.exploit_scenario: Attacker-influenced reviewer output enters a consolidator configured with unrestricted writer and bash tools running as the runner UID, permitting command-file poisoning or unauthorized worktree edits.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A03:2021-Injection / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Run consolidation with the non-writing reviewer role under a separate UID and accept only schema-validated output files.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A02:2021-Cryptographic Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Spoofing, Tampering
waivers.justification: validate.yml:924-947 exports the keyring to validate_process.sh, which launches the harness un-scrubbed at lines 3659-3666. Scope the keyring to isolated provenance verification and run Compose/tests under env -i.

finding.exploit_scenario: PR-controlled Compose configuration and validation scripts inherit the state-auth keyring and can exfiltrate it, enabling forged orchestrator state, promotion markers, and smoke envelopes.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A02:2021-Cryptographic Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Spoofing, Tampering
finding.recommendation: Unset the keyring before entering the checkout and pass it only via env -i to the immutable verification subprocess; run Compose and repository tests with a secret-free allowlisted environment.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_conflict_resolve.sh:513-525 invokes the shared writer from the PR workspace; write_opencode_config.sh:121 uses normal python3 -. Harden the shared writer with env -i and python3 -I -B, then use a fixed PATH for the credentialed actuator.

finding.exploit_scenario: Before resolver isolation begins, PR sitecustomize.py executes as the runner and can poison GITHUB_PATH or resolver artifacts; the following actuator then carries GitHub and state-auth credentials.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Generate OpenCode configuration under env -i python3 -I -B with runner command files inaccessible, then launch the credentialed actuator with an immutable clean PATH.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_run_judge_interim.sh:286-299 invokes the same non-isolated writer. GITHUB_PATH poisoning can reach the later keyring-bearing signing step; the shared isolated-writer fix and clean signing PATH are automatable.

finding.exploit_scenario: The invoked config writer starts stdin Python from the PR workspace, allowing sitecustomize.py to persist an attacker directory through GITHUB_PATH before subsequent provider- and keyring-bearing steps.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Make config generation use env -i python3 -I -B, remove runner command-file variables from its environment, and use a clean fixed PATH in subsequent credentialed steps.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: review_synthesise_smoke.sh:519-532 runs the shared writer immediately before review_autofix.yml:4392-4427 signs with the keyring. Isolate config generation and resolve signing tools from an immutable PATH.

finding.exploit_scenario: Checkout-controlled sitecustomize.py executes during config generation and can poison GITHUB_PATH so the following behavioural-smoke signing step runs attacker-controlled tools with the state-auth keyring.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Isolate config-writer Python with env -i and -I -B, deny access to runner command files, and resolve signing tools from immutable absolute paths.

waivers.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
waivers.justification: validate_driver.sh:234,273,471 uses non-isolated Python, while validate.yml:924-947 supplies GitHub, provider, notification, and state-auth secrets. Replace these launches with env -i python3 -I -B and scrub secrets before runtime tests.

finding.exploit_scenario: A PR can add sitecustomize.py, which this non-isolated Python launch imports from the checkout while GitHub, notification, and state-auth credentials remain inherited.
finding.owasp_or_stride_category: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures / STRIDE: Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege
finding.recommendation: Run every driver Python invocation through env -i python3 -I -B and expose only the explicit non-secret values each invocation requires.
